text: Rust Rich Presence worker and commands (discord_rpc), 15s coalesce, exit clear; Settings/UI transport not wired yet.
Settings General Discord section with three privacy toggles (presence off by default); transport not wired yet.
Main-window Rich Presence transport maps playback, downloads, and browsing to Discord via the Rust worker.
Island onboarding step for Rich Presence (introducedIn 0.4.0) plus Debugging preview.
Island onboarding Discord step uses Settings-path compact copy; SPIKE demo media removed pending a real presence screenshot.
Presence survives webview reload: transport no longer disables IPC on unmount; re-enable clears the 15s send floor.
Stop sending unuploaded ruforge art key (Discord can drop the whole activity); log IPC errors.
Re-enable always re-sends SET_ACTIVITY (clear last_sent); unknown art keys no longer sent.
Clarify Settings/onboarding copy for titles vs browsing (browsing off = media/download only).
Island onboarding visuals: espresso media frame for future presence card, clearer Settings-path compact + caption; Alt hold now finishes the Discord step after collapse.
Settings is a centered popup with categorized top tabs (icons + tonal pills), search across settings, not a full page.
Dialog height morph uses jump-then-spring (MotionValue), so the first tab swap after open springs like later ones.
Options menu is a ghost icon (no rest bubble); card hover shell and watch progress stay while the menu is open.
Removed placeholder Movie mode from the Alt radial cycle (Default / Music only). Stale movie localStorage maps to Default.
Fetching-details pacer spinner uses CSS animate-spin so it keeps turning while metadata work blocks the main thread.
Immersive download hero redesigned with poster, phase copy (preparing / downloading / finishing), ETA, and indeterminate bar so start stalls and end-of-file merge no longer look like a frozen 100%.
Header compact uses sticky tabs + IntersectionObserver so the title scrolls away instead of snap-collapsing outside the scrollport.
Compact collapses the title block with MORPH_SPRING height (not a hard unmount); shell stays always-on; content scroll drives compact.
Sidebar and Alt radial label Settings (was System).

Learning counters use atomic store bumps (no stale overwrite); empty UUID segments still track/auto-skip; Music mode records learning; settings tree line no longer cuts through labels, with learning progress badges.
Music mode only owns learning/auto-skip for audio files so a hidden PlayerView no longer double-counts video.

Panel height morph coalesces ResizeObserver ticks (rAF + settle) so compact/title and nested expands no longer restart the spring every layout frame; empty search can shrink; maxHeight tracks window resize; yt-dlp/Deno status fetch only on Downloads tab.
Overlay rf-scrollbar thumb. Native WebView2 bars hidden. Clips inside the well.
Deleted videos no longer return as ghost cards with broken thumbnails after you leave and come back; Recently Deleted loads Recycle Bin state in one pass.
Right-click and bar menus share one compact sectioned design with color-coded groups and viewport-safe placement.

Right-click tracks, artists, liked songs, and recently played for the shared music menu; glance stats use larger type-only numbers with compact this-week hints; library storage removed; recently played and highlights show a scroll-more cue; liked songs opened from profile return there on back.

Full stats page aligns hero and sections left with rank-to-play list rows; back returns to profile when opened from there; hero names your top track and artist; top track cards drop duplicate play overlay and rank badges read clearer on busy art.
Recently listened loads on startup with accurate finish times. Only the pre-refresh track resumes (after metadata loads); library picks start at 0. Scrubber hover shows preview time.
quadratic gain taper so low slider values are actually quiet; music bar shows %.
pasted single-track links download without opening the sidebar; hover labels stay off while the YouTube Music webview is up.
hide compact Dynamic Island when you are on the owning surface (paused music/player used to show a dead pill that could not expand).
Virtual playlists with Watch Later, create/add/remove, Playlists filter, and YouTube-style detail (sort, reorder, thumbnail).
library is home; download opens as an overlay from the rail dock, stop cancels the active job, and closing morphs the thumb into the dock chip.
Internal cookie mode no longer hangs on prepare; start skips a second metadata inspect; queued hydrations serialize cookie export and use direct yt-dlp inspect so multi-job queues transfer.
Recently added orders by newest download; singles show relative time, playlists show song count; hover shows pause when that track is playing; Explore singles stay dock-only.
Loop mode (all and one) now survives track skip, previous, and app refresh via session storage.
Expanded vinyl hero pockets the disc into the cover on track change, swaps art, then slides it back out (mirrored for previous).
Changing tracks clears segment state so auto-skip cannot seek using the previous song's ranges.
Expanded player can show optional synced or plain lyrics from the sidecar, with a calm empty state and manual lookup. Now-playing mic swaps available / unavailable variants from the track sidecar.
Center transport matches Spotify (shuffle, skip, play, skip, loop); ±15s skips removed; lyrics toggle uses a karaoke mic.
Opening lyrics shows a cached match immediately, then looks up from LRCLIB when needed; plain-text fallback and empty state when none exists.
Empty lyrics shows No lyrics found; edit artist/title then Look up cycles Looking up / No lyrics found (3s) back to Look up, with hover and press.

Now Playing rail peeks lyrics, beveled cards for related/about/credits/next (play + menu on next-up), Spotify-style header; About hero falls back through cover candidates so missing playlist art does not leave a blank frame; rail remounts on open for WebView2; mic stays fullscreen.
Custom dark accent color picker in Settings (opens beside the swatch in the Accent Color row).
Music shuffle is sticky like Spotify: on reshuffles up next, off restores source order, stays on across plays.
Held multi-link staging no longer fakes Preparing; Stop and Clear dismiss the whole batch; carousel centers and shows transfer progress.
Browse elapsed time stays stable across tab swaps; media progress ignores brief 0:00 flickers; main webview heartbeats every 15s and Rust clears stale presence after 45s.
panel sits above the video control bar; sort menu matches player menus and stacks over threads.
Default grid fits four thumbnails per row at wide widths with tighter spacing.
Expanded keyboard shortcuts (C captions, M mute, K play/pause, arrows, speed, seek) and Ctrl+D to open the paste-link downloader; download ETA tracks live speed better.
Loop one no longer sticks to every video or carries over when you skip tracks in Music; loop-one is per-file only, manual skip clears session loop.
Scrub hover segment pills (Intro, Highlight, etc.) use solid fills instead of glassy transparency.
Videos resume ~10 seconds before your last position again; music still starts fresh on each track.
Fix volume not applying on keyboard/slider changes and resume failing when reopening the same video.
YouTube-style center feedback for play/pause, volume, and captions; C always toggles or shows unavailable.
Volume changes ramp smoothly instead of popping when you nudge volume up or down.
Playback stays full-rate on a non-active monitor on Windows.
first app stack frame section opens by default.

Create playlists in RuForge Music from the sidebar, the Library Playlists tab, Ctrl+N, or Add to playlist on any song, album, or artist, then rename, reorder, search your library to fill them, and drag songs onto sidebar playlists.
finished tips stay finished after a refresh or restart mid-flow, and the Discord tip completes on its own when Discord activity is already on.

playlist Recommended now suggests songs from YouTube Music you don't own yet; Add downloads the song and drops it into the playlist, and every add slips two similar songs in right beside it. Turn it off in Settings > Audio.

playlists now save to a file in app data so they survive a cleared cache, follow songs that moved on the next rescan, take a description from Edit details, and export or import as .m3u8 (import reports lines it could not match).
right-click a song and choose Delete song to move it to the Recycle Bin, with the same confirm and restore path as the video library.
right-click a Recommended card under a playlist to hide that song or every song by its artist for good, with Undo and a list next to Refresh to bring them back.
Free internal space no longer lists a video twice when it is also in a playlist, so the Oldest order holds and the selected size is right.
Hovering or scrolling past cards in the Video Library no longer adds empty space at the bottom or makes the page jump.
Letting go of a short drag on the comments panel now snaps it fully open or closed instead of leaving it stuck partway.

the top search bar is now the one search. Typing shows matching songs, playlists, albums and artists from your library as you go, plus your recent searches and plays, and Enter opens the best match or searches YouTube Music when nothing in your library matches. The separate search box on Home is gone.

hover any card on a playlist's Recommended shelf and press play for a 15-second preview before adding it. Previews start at the song's most replayed part on YouTube (read from the download's info file for library songs), or near the first chorus when that isn't known. YouTube Music songs stream without downloading, and whatever was playing pauses and picks back up when the preview ends.
RuForge Internal cookies now work right after launch without opening Explorer or Music Explore first.
Music mode stays smooth while a song plays, even on long playlists, and finishing a track no longer stalls on a big listening history.

the queue checks free disk space and your library storage limit before a download starts, and rows that do not fit get a red border with Not enough storage (plus Authorize Cleanup when the library limit is the reason).
About the artist opens a sheet with a Wikipedia bio, artist photos, your plays and top tracks, and links to their socials.

Create > Import from screenshots copies a prompt for any chatbot, reads its reply, finds each song on YouTube for you to review and preview, and saves the picks as a playlist, reusing songs already in your library.

While RuForge is in the background, downloads and notices show in the island at the top of the screen you are using, with a progress ring around the music pill when something is playing. The bottom-right popup is gone.
the bottom bar now shows which YouTube page you are on and lets you paste a link to open it, reload, or copy the page URL, like Music's Explore bar.
progress no longer jumps to 100% at the start when captions are saved with the video.

the video library home is now laid out like YouTube, with rows of videos broken up by Continue watching, Shorts shelves, your playlists and "More from" channel shelves, plus channel avatars, publish dates and YouTube view counts kept apart from your own play count, and your YouTube home feed mixed in so you can preview any video in place and download it with one click. "More from" shelves show the channel you download most and the one you just followed, mixing your downloads with their newest, most viewed and already watched uploads. Click a creator's name or avatar, or pick Go to channel from a video's right-click menu, to open their page in RuForge: a banner card with their avatar, handle, subscriber and video counts, Follow and Open in YouTube, while the tabs along the top switch to Home, Videos, Downloaded and Playlists for that creator. Home has sideways-scrolling rows of your downloads, their latest and most popular uploads, your playlists of their videos and the ones you watched on YouTube. Videos there start on YouTube in Explorer with one click. Right-click any video to follow its creator (videos you haven't downloaded also get Download and Copy link).
The Alt radial menu now opens on top of the YouTube and YouTube Music pages instead of hiding behind them, including while the page has keyboard focus.
The left nav and the right panel (Now Playing, Queue, History) remember whether they were open or closed, and which tab, across restarts.
Follow YouTube channels from Explorer, the library or a pasted link, see their new uploads and premieres on Library home and the desktop island, and optionally auto-download them.
New notification center in the title bar, in every mode, collects new uploads and download results with one-click actions.
The export-to-drive title bar button is now off by default and can be turned back on in Settings > Export, which also keeps its own Export action.

the download pill at the top of your screen no longer appears while you're still in RuForge (clicking into Explorer used to trigger it); inside the app, download progress now shows in the title bar island instead. Click the download pill in either place to expand it into a list of active downloads with progress bars and an Open downloads button.
